title: Potato, roasted, from fresh, peel eaten, no added fat

content.title: About
content.content: Roasted potato is a whole tuber cooked without added fat. The skin is left on, preserving most of the dietary fiber and micronutrients. Potato is a major source of carbohydrates, B‑vitamins, vitamin C, and potassium.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Potatoes were introduced to Europe from South America in the 16th century and quickly became a staple food.
The skin contains more fiber and antioxidants than the flesh.
Roasting at high temperature creates aromatic compounds that give the characteristic taste and aroma.
There are over 4 000 potato varieties differing in colour, shape, and starch content.
Potatoes can be stored in a cool, dark place for several months without quality loss.

items.title: Rich in complex carbohydrates
items.content: Complex carbs provide sustained satiety and a steady blood‑glucose level.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potassium supports normal blood pressure and muscle function.

items.title: Vitamin C and antioxidants
items.content: Vitamin C boosts immunity, while skin antioxidants protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: The skin supplies fiber that promotes digestive health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B6 and B9 are involved in protein metabolism and DNA synthesis.

items.title: Solanine content
items.content: Green spots and sprouting can contain solanine, a toxin that should be removed.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Roasted potatoes have a high GI, so people with diabetes should watch portion sizes.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: Rarely, an allergic reaction to potato may occur.

items.title: Foodborne illness from improper storage
items.content: Storing in warm conditions can cause spoilage and toxin formation.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Roasted potato can be served as a standalone dish, cut into wedges, added to salads, soups, or used as a side. The skin is edible, especially when well‑washed.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep fresh potatoes in a cool, dark, dry place at 4‑10 °C. Do not refrigerate raw potatoes as it can alter flavor. Roasted potatoes keep in the refrigerator for 3‑4 days in an airtight container.
